subject: Re: MentorMix kickoff — staffing + Corpus v2 alignment
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Ondrej 50% (TL), Quentin 50% on benchmark reproduction, Wanjiru 40% on the platform API, Oyin 40% on the pilot-team integration. Stable through 06-15.

Compute — reproduction sweeps need 32 A100s on titan best-effort through April; the pilot training runs are smaller. No vulcan ask.

Corpus v2 alignment, per Jun: the team plans around a Corpus v2 freeze date of 2026-07-10, which is comfortably after our window closes on 06-15 — so all our pilot ingestion runs on v1 paths, and Wanjiru writes the API against the v1 interface with a documented v2 shim to hand over post-freeze. Jun's team signed off on that sequencing yesterday.

Only real dependency risk is pilot-team availability in early June; Oyin is lining up a backup team just in case.

Bruno
